_metadata.description: Tier-2 static persistence-hygiene analyzers migrated and re-homed from scenario-auditor (raw sql.Open, routed-driver imports, captured *sql.DB handles, unclosed rows, direct SQL in handlers) plus the new SQLite single-connection deadlock check. Exempt-path semantics (test files, migrations/, scripts/, packages/api-core/) preserved; parity-proven before any auditor rule is deleted.

requirements.title: Raw sql.Open and routed-driver-import analyzers
requirements.description: Detect raw sql.Open calls (RAW_SQL_OPEN, L3, ERROR — migrated from auditor `database_backoff`) and direct SQL-driver imports / sql.OpenDB outside api-core (ROUTED_DRIVER_IMPORT, L3, ERROR — migrated from `routed_database_drivers`). Persistence must route through database.Open.

validation.notes: A raw sql.Open in api/internal produces RAW_SQL_OPEN; the same in an exempt path (test file, migrations/) does not.
A non-blank pgx/lib-pq/go-sqlite3 import outside api-core produces ROUTED_DRIVER_IMPORT.

requirements.title: Handle-capture and unclosed-rows analyzers
requirements.description: Detect *sql.DB captured as a struct field / package var / parameter (SQL_DB_HANDLE_CAPTURE, L3, WARNING — migrated from `routed_database_handle_capture`) and rows that are never closed (DB_ROWS_NOT_CLOSED, L3, ERROR, autofixable — migrated from `db_rows_close`).

validation.notes: A *sql.DB struct field produces SQL_DB_HANDLE_CAPTURE; a *database.RoutedDB field does not.
A Query result used without defer rows.Close() produces DB_ROWS_NOT_CLOSED.

requirements.title: Direct-SQL-in-handlers and SQLite-pool-deadlock analyzers
requirements.description: New checks: SQL executed directly inside a transport handler (DIRECT_SQL_IN_HANDLERS, L3, WARNING) and the SQLite MaxOpenConns:1 + nested-query-inside-open-rows deadlock pattern (SQLITE_POOL_DEADLOCK, L3, ERROR).

validation.notes: SQL in an api/handlers/ function produces DIRECT_SQL_IN_HANDLERS.
A MaxOpenConns:1 pool with a nested query inside an open rows loop produces SQLITE_POOL_DEADLOCK.

requirements.title: Auditor parity
requirements.description: The migrated analyzers must produce verdicts equivalent to the original five scenario-auditor rules on the same inputs (parity tests) before any auditor rule is deleted, guarding against regressing routed E2E eligibility during the cutover.

validation.notes: For each migrated rule, identical inputs yield identical verdicts vs the original auditor rule fixtures.
